newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BANKS SEE BETTER 97 CYCLE - SERVICE BRANCH.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BANKS SEE BETTER 97 CYCLE - SERVICE BRANCH.

text.p: Finnish banks' cyclical expectations for 1997 are better than they were for 1996, the Confederation of Finnish Service Industries said on Tuesday.
"Expectations in the finance sector have improved," confederation official Heikki Almgren told a news conference.
He referred to the lobby's annual survey among service sector companies in November.
According to the survey, 64 percent of banks expected the business cycle to improve in 1997, 31 percent expected the cyclical outlook to remain unchanged and five percent expected it to deteriorate.
In the autumn 1995 survey only six percent of banks expected the business cycle to improve.
